result:
The work-item's four scenarios (r24, r32, r33, r34) now pass, and I've written the result as `DONE`. `python3 -m pytest -q --work-item w124` gives 142 passed, 1 skipped. `tests/scenarios/test_migration_tools.py` and `tests/scripts` give 141 passed, 1 skipped. `tools size --limit 300` printed nothing. I did not run the whole suite.

- **SessionStart:** `migrate status --hook` now adds what `work status` prints for each initiative that is neither `done` nor `abandoned`, after any version text. It adds nothing when none is open.
- **PreCompact:** `hooks/hooks.json` has a new PreCompact entry that runs a new `migrate compacting` command, in the new `scripts/migrate_session.py`.
  - It appends `- YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM: compacted` to each open initiative's ledger and commits those ledgers.
  - It prints text telling the session to write its hand-off with `work note` and then end instead of being compacted.
  - It always exits 0.
- **Retired scenario:** I removed the deprecated r24 scenario with `features retire`. `CLAUDE.md` has a new module-map row for `migrate_session.py`.
- **Tests:** the new steps are in `tests/scenarios/migration_session_steps.py`. The PreCompact test passes a git identity to the hook, because the commit it makes needs one.

Open questions the scenarios leave unchosen, all in the report:
- A non-UTF-8 `initiative.md` makes `work status` refuse. What the hooks then print is unchosen, and the SessionStart hook may raise instead of exiting 0.
- If the PreCompact commit fails, `committed` rolls the ledgers back and no hand-off text is printed.
- An `initiative.md` with no status counts as open, as it does in `work status`.
- Repeated compactions are not de-duplicated.
- I haven't established whether Claude Code delivers PreCompact stdout to the model.
- With `.shop/` present but no `.shop/work/`, both hooks say nothing about initiatives.

The report is at `.shop/scratch/3-implement/report.md`. The three commits are 5e21bac, c8c7e34 and 63bdb23.
